prompts.prompt:
Create a NEW complete FULL-BODY 3-by-3 expression sprite atlas of Xiaoyang, redrawing the same character shown in reference image 1. Image 1 is the accepted STYLE, FACE DESIGN and EMOTION reference: simple hand-drawn flat-color 2D anime. Image 2 is ONLY a whole-body outfit/proportion design reference. Do not copy image 2's 3D rendering, plastic skin or stiff mesh anatomy. The output must retain the accepted simple 2D animation style, never turn into 3D.

MOST IMPORTANT: ALL NINE figures must show the ENTIRE BODY from the top of the ponytail to the bottoms of BOTH SHOES. This is a full-length character sheet, not bust portraits. Show the whole head, both arms and hands, full skirt, both full legs, ankles and two complete shoes in EVERY cell, including all three figures in the bottom row. NO cropped legs, no cropped feet, no waist-up figures, no close-up panels. Uniform front-facing camera, same figure scale and natural anime proportions in all nine cells, consistent head height and feet baseline. The entire body must fit comfortably with generous transparent padding.

DESIGN: white/silver hair with pale-blue inner layers, ONE high side ponytail on viewer's RIGHT with pale-blue tie, long side locks, blue upper irises and pink lower iris accents, black/navy school blazer over white collared shirt, gray plaid bow and gray plaid pleated skirt. Keep bare legs without adding stockings. The original full-body reference is barefoot; for this complete school-outfit variant ADD a simple matched pair of flat black low-cut student loafers, no heel, no decoration, no shiny material. These shoes are a minimal new outfit completion, not a new costume. Keep the same ordinary youthful school character age and face as the accepted 2D atlas. Do not draw chibi or exaggerated doll proportions. Both shoes must be completely visible.

STYLE: clean thin 2D anime outlines, flat peach skin, natural drawn facial features, hair summarized into big white and pale-blue flat color shapes. At most one or two crisp hard-edge shadow shapes per material. Plain flat black/navy blazer with very few folds. Simplified plaid lines. No gradients or airbrush, no realistic cloth texture, no plastic highlights, no 3D body volume, no glossy hair, no painterly lighting. Match image 1's drawing while making the full body visible.

Exact left-to-right, top-to-bottom cell order:
TOP LEFT neutral: calm open eyes, relaxed small closed mouth, both arms naturally resting at sides.
TOP CENTER happy: clear happy smile, eyes bright or gently smiling, one hand near chest.
TOP RIGHT sad: downcast sad brows, slightly lowered gaze, small downturned mouth, relaxed arms.
MIDDLE LEFT angry: visibly furrowed brows, firm unhappy mouth, one small fist near waist.
MIDDLE CENTER surprised: wide eyes, raised brows, small open mouth, one open hand lightly raised near collarbone.
MIDDLE RIGHT shy: simple pink cheek blush, bashful sideways glance, small embarrassed smile, one hand loosely near chest.
BOTTOM LEFT thinking: thoughtful expression, one hand at chin, other arm naturally down.
BOTTOM CENTER serious: focused direct gaze, firm neutral mouth, attentive straight posture, relaxed arms.
BOTTOM RIGHT relieved: gently closed eyes, soft small relieved smile, one hand over upper chest.

Small natural hand gestures only; no wild limb poses, no crossed-through arms, no interpenetration, anatomically correct hands and fingers. Legs stay in a simple comfortable standing stance, both feet planted on the same invisible ground baseline in each cell; no ground or shadow drawn.

LAYOUT: one tall 2:3 portrait PNG, ideally 1536 x 2304 pixels. Invisible grid of three columns and three rows, each ideally 512 x 768. Place each entire full-length figure centered in its own cell, occupying only around 75–80% of the cell height and no more than 65% of its width. Leave at least 10% empty transparent space ABOVE the complete ponytail and at least 10% BELOW both shoe soles, in EVERY cell. Wide empty transparent gutters between all nine figures. Do not enlarge the bottom row. Nothing crosses cell boundaries or touches the outside image edges.

True transparent alpha background, with fully opaque character interiors and normal narrow antialiased edges. No background color, no scenery, no checkerboard, no UI, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no watermark, no ground shadows. Deliver exactly nine complete head-to-toe 2D figures.

prompts.prompt:
Edit this FULL-BODY 3x3 Xiaoyang atlas. Keep the exact same accepted flat 2D anime drawing style, character design, nine facial expressions, hand poses, gray plaid school uniform, bare legs and black low-cut loafers. Do not redesign or add any detail.

ONLY FIX THE LAYOUT: the figures are currently too tall for their cells. Make EACH ENTIRE FIGURE approximately 20% SMALLER, without cropping any body part. Keep the same natural body proportions. Center the smaller figures inside an exact invisible 3-column by 3-row grid. Use the same head size and total body height for ALL NINE. Every cell must have a visibly large transparent gap above the ponytail and below BOTH shoe soles. Make the three rows clearly separated by wide transparent horizontal gutters.

Use a 1024x1536 portrait canvas, 2:3 aspect. Each cell is approximately 341x512. Desired full-body landmarks:
top row: highest hair around y=50, soles around y=455;
middle row: highest hair around y=562, soles around y=967;
bottom row: highest hair around y=1074, soles around y=1479.
These are full figures, not cropped rectangles: keep the entire ponytail, both arms/hands, complete skirt, both legs and both shoes between those positions. The first, second and third column body centers are approximately x=171,512,853. Keep the whole figure width within its own column with wide empty gutters. There must be at least 45 pixels of genuinely transparent space beneath the bottom-row shoes, and the same empty margin in each row. No shoe or ponytail may touch the cell edges.

Preserve exact emotion order: neutral, happy, sad / angry, surprised, shy / thinking, serious, relieved. Preserve flat skin and thin clean anime outlines; no 3D volume or glossy plastic. Shoes are simple flat black school loafers with no socks. Keep BOTH soles at the same relative vertical baseline in every cell.

Output ONE transparent RGBA PNG. The apparent gray lighting backdrop in the preview is NOT a desired design: remove all backdrop and all ground shadows so every area outside the nine character silhouettes is truly transparent alpha=0, with no halo. Opaque character interiors and narrow ordinary antialiased contour edges. No text, labels, panel borders, grids, UI, scenery or watermark. Do not zoom in; smaller complete figures and wide empty gutters are the purpose of this edit.

validation.styleNotes: Retains thin drawn contours, flat anime facial design, simplified hair color areas and restrained school-uniform shading. Both bare legs and both complete black loafers are visible in every frame; no bottom-row leg/foot crop.
validation.cropNotes: Custom 290x460 rectangles. At alpha >=20 and >=120 all nine frame edges have zero occupied pixels. Shoe baseline is approximately frame-relative y=441..445, with transparent margin below all soles. Bottom-row heads sit roughly 15 pixels lower than top/middle row, while shoe baselines stay aligned; no pixel shifting or drawing was performed.
validation.alphaNotes: Unchanged tool PNG. Dark/gray RGB background shown by the preview is transparent in the source alpha (sampled gutter alpha values 0 or 1). Actual alpha range is 0..254. No programmatic background removal or repainting.
validation.scope: Image generation, visual review and read-only alpha/geometry inspection only; no browser/GPU/build or production-code changes.
